newsitem.title: USA: Advanced NMR cuts stake in Advanced Mammography.
newsitem.headline: Advanced NMR cuts stake in Advanced Mammography.

text.p: Advanced Mammography Systems Inc said Advanced NMR Systems Inc will cut its stake in Advanced Mammography to 16.4 percent because the company did not meet certain milestone agreements.

Advanced NMR will return 2.75 million shares to Advanced Mammography's treasury, cutting its stake to 1.25 million shares. The move will also cut the number of Advanced Mammography's outstanding shares by 27 percent reduction.

The 2.75 million shares are a portion of the 4 million shares originally issued to Advanced NMR and placed in escrow in connection with Advanced Mammography's January 1993 IPO, pending the achievement of certain milestones

These milestones included Advanced Mammography meeting certain threshold amounts of pretax net income, or the average closing bid price of the company's common stock reaching specific threshold price levels for certain prescribed periods.
